notes.title: Localization update, V.1.0.5
notes.content:
Added localization.

Fixed "Head Hunter" tutorial.
Fixed lobby mouse scroll issue.
Fixed "The Drop" tutorial.
Fixed "Flying Ram tutorial.

Special thanks to "MonkeyoChaos" for reporting the bugs.

notes.title: Update V1.0.3 new game! "Duel Frenzy"
notes.content:
We added a new game for you to enjoy! 

Set in Wild West, you'll be playing as a sheriff who has little resources at his disposal and have to fight criminals like old times. Challenge them to a duel and rid this town from criminals.

Be the sheriff this town needs!

tags.feature: We added a new game for you to enjoy!
